configuration.authorization: User requested parallel testing using all eight allocated Azure VMs.
configuration.candidate_formula: On eligible rows: v7 + candidate_weight * (family_prediction - v7); all other rows exactly v7.
configuration.fit_population_policy: Natural controls use original fitting rows with missing NM origin AND missing NM clock. Augmented variants use ALL original fitting rows; every predictor uses the same NM-blind view. No target-value filters.
configuration.prediction_route: Only rows with missing NM origin AND missing NM clock may change. Every other prediction is exactly v7.
configuration.prior_information: v7 and the completed non-qualifying Rome experiment are known. Joint NM masking has not been trained or scored. Naturally missing NM origin is distinct from missing NM clock.
configuration.refit_policy: Only after qualification and both platform verifiers, separately declare January-November refit with all December flight groups protected; tree counts are rounded medians of the two October-selected counts.
configuration.sample_weight_policy: Natural controls have unit weights. Augmented natural rows have weight 0.5 and other rows weight 0.5*n_natural/n_other, giving each cohort half the total fitting weight and keeping total weight n_natural.
configuration.selection: Finish all eight jobs and twelve common candidates; require at least 0.5% lower complete RMSE on BOTH original folds; eligible winner minimizes equal-weight mean relative RMSE, then lexical recipe.
configuration.stopping_policy: Same original October stopping IDs restricted to naturally missing NM origin AND clock, with unit weights for every variant.
configuration.target: taxi-out minus the unchanged conditional schedule offset evaluated in the NM-masked feature view
